summary: The proposal introduces a method to join streaming data with external storage by performing on-demand lookups instead of loading the entire static side. The discussion proposes merging the GraphFrames library into the Apache Spark project as an in‑tree module, aiming to provide a unified DataFrame‑based graph API and improve long‑term maintenance. Szehon Ho proposes a Spark 3.5.10 release to provide security fixes and extend the 3.5 LTS period until November 2027, following the recent 4.3 RC3 vote. The PR introduces an opt‑in extension point that lets users supply a custom java.util.Comparator to order Spark’s root pool, exposing only a minimal immutable SchedulableInfo API and a new configuration property.
